what: loop closure over {TMC-2 ortho, NAC A, NAC D} (Part 1 §5)
frame: RD04-long tiles degraded to the TMC-2 GSD, north-up-east-right
edge_independence: Each edge was estimated by a separate run of the baseline on its own image pair. The closing edge was NOT derived as (T_AD o T_TA)^-1; that derivation is E-021 and manufactures a zero residual.

reasons: Loop closure fails: composing the three estimated transforms around the image triplet leaves 2.21 px of error instead of returning to the start. A uniformly shifted -- and therefore perfectly self-consistent -- wrong answer cannot hide from this.
Correspondences are clustered: 0.408 of the overlap has no nearby constraint, so the alignment is extrapolated there even if it is accurate where the points are.

evidence.name: n_inliers
evidence.statement: 29 inliers, above the reject threshold. Weak positive evidence only: this rule's false-alarm rate was 0.369 in a mixed regime (EXP-003), so a high count is not proof of correctness.

evidence.name: loop_error_px
evidence.statement: Loop closure 2.21 px (reject at >= 2.0). Detection 1.000 at false alarm 0.000 (EXP-003).

evidence.name: coverage_max_gap
evidence.statement: Largest unconstrained region is 0.408 of the image (target <= 0.15). The transform is extrapolating where there are no correspondences.

evidence.name: inlier_ratio
evidence.statement: 29/29 putative matches survived geometric verification. Self-consistency only: misses 8.7% of failures (EXP-002).

evidence.name: fit_rmse
evidence.statement: Reported for transparency and EXCLUDED from the verdict. ROC AUC 0.4947 as a failure detector on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002 objective 3, pre-declared negative control). Inverted in the failure regime: EXP-001 measured 10 of 17 catastrophic failures reporting fit RMSE below 1e-12 px while 190-2400 px wrong.

excluded.fit_rmse: ROC AUC 0.4947 as a failure detector on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002 objective 3, pre-declared negative control). Inverted in the failure regime: EXP-001 measured 10 of 17 catastrophic failures reporting fit RMSE below 1e-12 px while 190-2400 px wrong.
excluded.held_out_residual: Detection 0.200 against coherent wrong solutions (EXP-002 objective 4, ADR-0011). A match set 64 px wrong yielded 0.468 px -- lower than a correct-but-noisy set at 1.424 px. Degeneracy detector only.
excluded.cycle_consistency: Blind to symmetric errors by construction (E-012): forward +64 px and backward -64 px cancel exactly, scoring 0.000 on wrong cases against 0.325 on the correct one -- an inverted signal.

claims_not_supported: No ground truth; loop closure is a self-consistency bound.
Loop closure is exactly invariant to per-image gauge error (ADR-0011 N1): it verifies the transform set only up to that gauge.
One triplet, one region, one TMC-2 strip. No significance claim.
